messages.content: "Can you tell me how many all-time goals Cristiano Ronaldo scored for Manchester United in the Premier League, then compare that with the top scorer of Manchester United in the same competition, and finally, tell me who was the top scorer of the Premier League in the 2019-2020 season?"

function.name: team_stats_get_top_scorer
function.description: Fetch the top scorer of a specified football team. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the football team.

competition.description: Competition for which to fetch stats (optional). Default is 'Premier League' if not specified.

function.name: league_stats_get_top_scorer
function.description: Fetch the top scorer of a specified football league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league_name.description: The name of the football league.

season.description: Season for which to fetch stats (optional). Default is '2019-2020' if not specified.

function.name: player_stats_get_all_time_goals
function.description: Fetch all-time goals scored by a particular football player for a specified team. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

player_name.description: The name of the football player.

team_name.description: The name of the team for which player has played.

competition.description: Competition for which to fetch stats (optional). Default is 'Premier League' if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants three pieces of information:

1. All‑time goals Cristiano Ronaldo scored for Manchester United in the Premier League.
2. The top scorer of Manchester United in the Premier League (the club’s all‑time top scorer in that competition).
3. The top scorer of the Premier League in the 2019‑2020 season.

We have two relevant tools:

- `player_stats_get_all_time_goals` – can give Ronaldo’s all‑time goals for Manchester United in the Premier League.
- `team_stats_get_top_scorer` – can give Manchester United’s all‑time top scorer in the Premier League.
- `league_stats_get_top_scorer` – can give the Premier League top scorer for the 2019‑2020 season.

We need to call each tool separately. The user’s request is a single question but it requires three distinct data points. We should ask for each piece of data in separate calls. The user explicitly asked for all three, so we can proceed to call the tools.
